# A node a population declares is read through the node it populates,
# `c.m.e`, and the checked dump has to print it that way to check again.

sngl dump --stage checked --format sngl app.sngl
stdout 'c\.m\.e\.length\(\)'
cp stdout out.sngl
sngl check out.sngl
stdout 'out.sngl: ok'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component maybe(extra list[component(i int) node]) node {
    vbox {
        for var i = [1, 2] {
            extra(i)
        }
    }
}

component screen node {
    maybe #m {
        component extra(i) {
            text #e(value="{i}")
        }
    }
}

func testIt(t Test, c screen) {
    t.assert(c.m.e.length() == 2)
}
